WITH q1998 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries) AS avg_weekly_wage
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.1998_q1`
  WHERE geoid = '42003'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT AVG(avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.1998_q2`
  WHERE geoid = '42003'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT AVG(avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.1998_q3`
  WHERE geoid = '42003'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT AVG(avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.1998_q4`
  WHERE geoid = '42003'
),
q2017 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries) AS avg_weekly_wage
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2017_q1`
  WHERE geoid = '42003'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT AVG(avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2017_q2`
  WHERE geoid = '42003'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT AVG(avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2017_q3`
  WHERE geoid = '42003'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT AVG(avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2017_q4`
  WHERE geoid = '42003'
),
wages AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT AVG(avg_weekly_wage) FROM q1998) AS wage_1998,
    (SELECT AVG(avg_weekly_wage) FROM q2017) AS wage_2017
),
cpi AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = 1998 THEN value END) AS cpi_1998,
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2017 THEN value END) AS cpi_2017
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpi_u`
  WHERE area_code = 'A104' AND item_name = 'All items' AND period = 'S01'
)
SELECT 
  w.wage_1998,
  w.wage_2017,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(w.wage_2017 - w.wage_1998, w.wage_1998) * 100, 2) AS wage_growth_pct,
  c.cpi_1998,
  c.cpi_2017,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(c.cpi_2017 - c.cpi_1998, c.cpi_1998) * 100, 2) AS cpi_growth_pct
FROM wages w CROSS JOIN cpi c
